AI Content Creation im D2C-Box-Business
Wir verabschieden uns von starren, langsamen Prozessen und setzen auf eine hochmoderne, KI-gestützte Design-Pipeline. Für diesen innovativen Workflow suchen wir ein kreatives Talent, das generative KI als seinen primären Hebel versteht, um Bild- und Video-Assets in hoher Schlagzahl und herausragender Ästhetik zu erschaffen.

Seit über 16 Jahren sind wir die führende D2C-Plattform für FMCG-Neuprodukte in Deutschland. Mit unseren monatlichen Boxen bringen wir insbesondere Food- und Beverage-Innovationen direkt in die Haushalte zehntausender Konsument:innen – und liefern damit mehr als 600 Konsumgüterherstellern – von Barilla über Just Spices bis Seeberger – wertvolle Trial-Momente, Insights und Awareness.
Nun wollen wir uns zu einer AI-First-Company entwickeln und hier kommst du ins Spiel!
Aufgaben
🚀 Deine Aufgaben: Generative Kreation & High-Speed-Workflow
KI-gestützte Bildgenerierung: Konzipieren und Erstellen von fotorealistischen Produkt-Lifestyle-Szenen, Ambientebildern und kreativen Brand-Assets mittels führender Generatoren wie Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion und Adobe Firefly.
Video-Prompting & AI-Motion: Generieren und Editieren von dynamischen Kurzvideos und Social Ads mithilfe von Video-KIs, sowie das Verfassen hochpräziser Prompts für Kamerafahrten, Lichtstimmungen und visuelle Effekte.
Hybride Postproduktion & Veredelung: Professionelles Nachbearbeiten und Verfeinern der KI-generierten Entwürfe in Adobe Photoshop (Compositing, Retusche, Upscaling, Freistellung) sowie finaler Videoschnitt in Premiere Pro oder CapCut Pro.
Performance- & Conversion-Design: Gestalten von verkaufspsychologisch optimierten Infografiken, Landingpage-Elementen und A+ Content für unseren Onlineshop und unsere Marktplätze.
Datengestützte Iteration: Kontinuierliches Optimieren und Anpassen der Creatives auf Basis von Marketing-KPIs (wie CTR und Conversion-Rate).
Pipeline-Automatisierung: Aktives Mitgestalten, Testen und Automatisieren unserer kreativen Workflows mit modernen AI-Tools zur drastischen Verkürzung der Time-to-Market.
Qualifikation
🎯 Dein Profil: Technologische Neugier & Design-Verständnis
Fachlicher Hintergrund: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediengestaltung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einem aussagekräftigen, durch KI-Arbeiten ergänzten Portfolio.
Erfahrung im digitalen Raum: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Design, idealerweise gesammelt im E-Commerce-Umfeld, in einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur oder einer agilen DTC-Brand.
Herausragende Tool-Kompetenz: Tiefgehende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Suite (insbesondere Photoshop und Premiere Pro) sowie Figma.
AI-Expertise & Prompting-Skills: Nachweisbare Praxis und Begeisterung im Prompt Engineering für generative Bild- und Videosysteme sowie ein feines Gespür für Ästhetik, Bildkomposition und Materialität.
E-Commerce Mindset: Das tiefgehende Verständnis dafür, dass herausragendes visuelles Design im Onlinehandel kein Selbstzweck ist, sondern direkt den Markenwert und den Umsatz steigert.

About Co-Star
Someone downloads Co–Star every 5 seconds.
In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app. Big Sean has rapped about us, Ariana Grande & Kevin Durant post screenshots to their IGs, and we've been App of the Day twice. We've been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of NYT Style. We have a global following, in 193 countries – missing just North Korea and Eritrea.
We don't pay for marketing – we designed the app to go viral, and it did.
Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years.
Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you're experiencing, and how you relate to other people – in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It's a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.
Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on. An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.
We're merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.
Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, Co–Star generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes – a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person's unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. Co–Star combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called "wildly beautiful."
We're a small, experienced team.
Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).
About The Brand Designer Role

About Symbiotic
Symbiotic is the infrastructure beneath collateral markets, where capital can secure financial obligations, remain productive, and be enforced by code.
By changing the economics of onchain collateral, Symbiotic enables new categories of neofinance applications that were previously impossible to build - including credit, insurance, RWA liquidity, and more.
As institutional capital increasingly moves onchain, Symbiotic is positioned to become the coordination layer connecting capital and risk across the onchain economy.
Backed by Paradigm, Pantera, Cyber.fund, and Coinbase Ventures, we power 80+ vaults, 74,000+ active stakers, and 111 operators - with Chainlink, Nexus Mutual, and Cap Labs among the teams live in production.

Build something that truly matters
At Cortea , we envision a world where every audit is proactively managed by humans and AI agents collaboratively . Where auditing professionals have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips to strengthen the trust in the world's most critical systems.
We're not just improving auditing workflows, we're redefining how audits are done from the ground up. With a rapidly growing, global customer base and backing from world-class investors, the market is ready. What we ship next decides how big this gets.
This is your chance to join a team of sharp, ambitious and kind builders extremely early. Shape the company at its pivotal moment and build something that truly matters .

At Cortea, design earns trust, and we sell to an industry that exists to produce it. Auditors are paid to be skeptical, and people judge quality by what they can see: the product, the website, the deck a partner opens in a boardroom, the newsletter someone reads with their first coffee. All of it is Cortea.
This is a role for someone with great taste in designing software and AI systems. You'll find novel patterns for problems that haven't existed in software before, and you'll own how Cortea looks and feels to the outside world.
Roughly 70% product, 30% brand . The product work is deep, expert-facing and systems-heavy. As we are doubling down on design, you'll be working on taking the core flows to the next level. The brand work is yours to own outright: website, marketing and sales visuals, newsletter, event and content assets. It'll be on screen in a Big4 boardroom, in every customer's inbox, and on the wall at the events we host. A lot of surface for one designer, and all of it yours.
We're not looking for someone to ask whether the logo goes left or right. We're looking for someone with opinions.

Work directly with our founders, engineers, and customers to turn audit flows into intuitive, delightful interfaces
Work with Jonas on product design and design strategy overall
Own our brand designs and visuals
Evolve our visual identity and design system
Take increasing ownership of brand direction. Website, marketing and sales material, content and event assets
Help shape the product vision, roadmap, and user experience standards
Run usability tests, build user feedback loops, and bring a systems mindset to design decisions
You'll be great at this if you
Have product design experience in B2B / SaaS , ideally in fast-moving startups.
Think in experiences, not screens. With taste you can defend. Product and brand are one surface; you can explain why details work, and you call out when they don’t.
Want to create a unique brand, which auditors love . Identify, marketing, web should be a draw, not a tax. Taste and passion matter more than volume.
Can hold complexity without losing clarity. You turn configuration-heavy, expert workflows into clear systems.
Use AI without sacrificing quality. You've worked out which parts of the job benefit from automation and which need your judgment.
Work well in ambiguity. You take rough direction and deliver great work without handholding.
Have low ego. Best idea wins. You give and take feedback without making it about you.
Titles are fuzzy. If you're operating at principal level, or you're currently freelancing and curious rather than actively looking, talk to us anyway.

Full brand ownership, shape how the product feels . Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.
Real influence on strategy . In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.
Fast, ambitious, and fun team . Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.
Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.
Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.
You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.
What you'll own
Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem
Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.
Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards
Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles
Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries
Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)
Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.
Build scalable creative systems powered by AI
You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.
Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.
You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.
Raise the creative standard across OLX Group
As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.
You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.
Translate strategy into brand experiences
You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.
You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.
Drive adoption and influence across the organisation
Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.
You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.
You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.
Mentor and elevate the craft
As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.
You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.
You create brands that people trust
Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.
You think in systems
You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.
You bring strategy to life through Design
You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.
You're fluent in AI-enabled Design
You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.
You influence without authority
You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.
You bring depth of experience

10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design
Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets
Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite
Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences
Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems
Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows
Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
